$schema: lib/carousel/image-prompts.ts — every image the system can render has a prompt template here.
_notes: Workflow: 1) Pick a template by asset_class. 2) Resolver fills {variables} from the spec. 3) Copy the rendered prompt into ChatGPT image-gen / Gemini Imagen / Midjourney. 4) Drop the output PNG/JPG in the path under public/images/.

editorial-cream-photography.label: Editorial cream — magazine-grade photography (default for builder + behavior)
editorial-cream-photography.base: Modern editorial magazine photography, shot on Hasselblad medium format, soft natural side-light from a north-facing window, warm cream paper backdrop (#F5F0E5), single subject in centered composition with generous negative space, contemplative mood, restrained color palette of cream + charcoal + a single saturated red accent (#C8252D), photorealistic, sharp focus, subtle film grain.
editorial-cream-photography.negative: NEVER: no illustration, no sketch, no 3D render, no cartoon, no neon, no anime, no pastel, no clipart, no stock-photo look, no AI-glossy plastic finish, no extra fingers.

premium-dark-cinematic.label: Premium dark — cinematic side-lit photography (default for trading vertical)
premium-dark-cinematic.base: Cinematic editorial photography, shot on ARRI Alexa, single low-angle rim light from screen-left, near-black backdrop (#0B0B0B), high-contrast tonal range, single subject in the lower third of the frame, institutional orange accent (#FF6B3D) confined to one small element only, mood: late-night Bloomberg terminal, photorealistic, sharp focus, subtle motion-blur on background only.
premium-dark-cinematic.negative: NEVER: no illustration, no sketch, no 3D render, no cartoon, no neon, no anime, no pastel, no clipart, no AI-glossy plastic finish.

warm-dark-cinematic.label: Warm dark — late-evening study lamp aesthetic (CTA outros)
warm-dark-cinematic.base: Cinematic photography lit by a single warm tungsten desk lamp (3200K), deep brown bookcase background (#1F1812), single subject (object or hands), 50mm f/1.4 shallow depth of field, warm cream highlights (#F4E8D9) on the subject, accent of warm tangerine (#E89B5C), mood: end-of-evening journal entry, photorealistic, sharp focus, organic film grain.
warm-dark-cinematic.negative: NEVER: no illustration, no sketch, no 3D render, no cartoon, no neon, no anime, no pastel, no clipart, no overhead flat-lay shots.

claude-mint.label: Claude-mint — soft mint paper variant for Claude-themed builder content
claude-mint.base: Editorial magazine photography, soft natural light, cream paper backdrop with a mint-green (#B8E0C8) detail in-frame (a coffee cup, a notebook tab, a sticky note), single subject in centered composition, contemplative mood, photorealistic, shot on Hasselblad medium format.
claude-mint.negative: NEVER: no illustration, no sketch, no 3D render, no cartoon, no overly green tint, no anime, no pastel, no clipart.

courseware-cover.label: Courseware cover — Gumroad product art (square 1:1)
courseware-cover.base: Editorial product cover designed for a Gumroad course thumbnail at 1080x1080. Bold serif type-led layout, single accent color, generous negative space, minimal photographic element (a single object or hands holding the subject), Hasselblad medium-format quality, photorealistic, restrained palette.
courseware-cover.negative: NEVER: no illustration, no sketch, no 3D render, no cluttered text, no neon, no anime, no clipart, no stock-photo look.

x-banner-cinematic.label: X / Twitter header — wide cinematic 3:1 frame
x-banner-cinematic.base: Cinematic wide-frame photography at 1500x500 (3:1 aspect), wide negative space left of the focal subject, single subject in the right third of the frame, photorealistic, restrained palette, mood matching the vertical (warm cream for builder/behavior, near-black for trading).
x-banner-cinematic.negative: NEVER: no illustration, no sketch, no 3D render, no clipart, no cluttered composition.

educational-modern.label: Educational modern — premium clean explainer graphic (for 5-image teaching posts)
educational-modern.base: Premium modern educational graphic, Apple-keynote / editorial-infographic quality. Clean composition on a warm cream backdrop (#F5F0E5) OR deep near-black (#0B0B0B) depending on accent. One bold central visual metaphor, generous negative space, crisp geometric shapes, a single saturated accent color, refined sans-serif numerals/labels baked into the image, soft realistic shadows, high-contrast, gallery-grade. Looks like a frame from a top-tier explainer video.
educational-modern.negative: NEVER: no childish clipart, no hand-drawn sketch, no doodle, no stock-photo people, no neon, no anime, no pastel mush, no AI-glossy plastic finish, no cluttered busy backgrounds, no lorem-ipsum, no garbled text.
